purpose: Improve discovery of ten paired technical guides, clarify four search-intent topics and establish a read-only index/performance baseline.
publication: Draft only. No approval to merge PR69 or this SEO batch.

review.type: Two-pass self AI review of paired editorial meaning and generated output; no independent or human review claimed.

findings.issue: Search impressions alone do not identify keyword search volume or prove an optimization effect.
findings.resolution: Describe the selection as editorial prioritization using prior site impressions; preserve snapshot periods and avoid ranking/CTR improvement claims.

findings.issue: HTTP200, a matching canonical and an accepted API response do not prove Google indexing.
findings.resolution: Separate live route checks, Google indexed-version responses, API errors and metadata/refresh signals. Legacy HTTP200 refreshes are not reported as server301 redirects.

findings.issue: A failed API response or an omitted analytics row could be treated as deindexing or zero traffic.
findings.resolution: Exclude API failures from state comparisons and retain missing rows as unreturned. Document top-row and anonymization limits.

findings.issue: Historical Temurin news and release-asset metadata could imply current release delay or a verified download.
findings.resolution: Lead with present metadata lookup and retain the historical notice and no-download/no-hash boundaries.
